name: CM-IR-02 PLC program or mode change
displayName: CM-IR-02 PLC program or mode change
description: An OpenPLC program upload, start, or stop reached a PLC. Decide whether it was the approved vendor work or an unauthorized change, contain it without tripping the plant, and restore the known-good program. DESIGN.md 13 and 14.

tasks.title: Match the change to an approved vendor window and work order
tasks.description: Look for Wazuh 100201/100301/100311 (tunnel, Guacamole login, RDP) in the two hours before; Zeek PLC_Change_During_Vendor_Session and Suricata sid 9000151 in Malcolm. No approval record means unauthorized.

tasks.title: Name the PLC and the process area it controls
tasks.description: plc-cellar: fermenters and the CO2 interlock inputs; plc-utilities: CO2 supply, glycol, steam; plc-power: ATS, BESS, load shed. Call the shift lead before touching anything.

tasks.title: Ask operations whether the process is in a safe state
tasks.description: Read the HMI and the historian, not the PLC. Life safety (CO2 tiers on bas-vent) outranks evidence.

tasks.title: Cut the vendor path if the change was not approved
tasks.description: Disable the WireGuard peer on dmz-vpn and the Guacamole account; keep the session recording.

tasks.title: Preserve the evidence
tasks.description: Guacamole recording, EWS auth.log and cm-plc-tool syslog, the Malcolm sessions (Arkime pcap) of the EWS-to-PLC REST session, and the running program's checksum.

tasks.title: Restore the known-good program from the engineering baseline
tasks.description: Upload the baseline ZIP with cm_plc_tool from the EWS during a window agreed with operations; confirm STATUS:RUNNING and the interlocks.

tasks.title: Record the timeline and the reporting decision
tasks.description: Detect, acknowledge, contain, and recover times; whether CISA (CIRCIA) or the insurer must be told (DESIGN.md 18A.7).
